record_semantics: class_requirements describe the PROPOSED TASK DESIGN for each candidate, not the historical candidate commit. The historical replay supplies the two OBSERVED oracle statuses; anything not yet materialised is listed in pending_requirements and blocks round admission. Disclosures carry the historical facts that differ from the proposed design.

A_REPAIR.definition: real defect repair; the oracle is red at the base and green at the candidate

B_REGRESSION_GUARD.definition: verification of a protective capability; the oracle is green at the baseline and a mutation that touches the target predicate turns it red

C_REJECT.definition: not admissible under any class; every rejection carries enumerated trigger codes and the blocked-class reasoning

reject_triggers.WORKER_MODIFIES_VALIDATOR: the verdict-deciding harness or validator bytes are inside the worker's delta
reject_triggers.WORKER_MODIFIES_TEST_ORACLE: the test oracle bytes are inside the worker's delta
reject_triggers.ACCEPTANCE_SURFACE_IN_WORKER_SCOPE: the verdict-producing surface is authored by the worker
reject_triggers.SELF_PROVING_HASH: a hash the acceptance relies on is computed from worker-writable bytes
reject_triggers.OBSERVATION_COVERAGE_UNPROVEN: no frozen acceptance can observe the target predicate (sub-reasons: ORACLE_SATISFIABLE_WITHOUT_THE_PREDICATE, SPECIMEN_SET_DOES_NOT_COVER_THE_PREDICATE, NO_GATE_OBSERVES_THE_DELIVERABLE)
reject_triggers.BASE_CANDIDATE_NOT_COMPARABLE: the base and the candidate are not comparable under one frozen delivery and one oracle

enforced_recomputed_here: IDENTITY — the record's corpus_case_id must name a case whose revision pair AND source repository equal the record's; both are read from the replay corpus, whose sha256 is pinned by a literal in the validator; the corpus is pinned TWICE (its sha256 as a literal in the validator, the per-case pairs of all five cases as a literal in the test file)

DERIVED TRIGGERS — the pair's changed-file list is read from the object database; a changed test file derives WORKER_MODIFIES_TEST_ORACLE and a changed validate_*/check_* file derives WORKER_MODIFIES_VALIDATOR (NOT derived: configuration such as ruff.toml, CI workflows, conftest.py — those must be declared by hand); the rules are NAME-based and therefore blind to ROLE — r02's scripts/review_evidence.py is a collect/validate CLI that derives nothing, so a task whose verdict hangs on such a file must declare the trigger by hand
REVISION BINDING — git cat-file resolution, ancestry for admissible claims, refusal of a degenerate base == candidate pair
an externally bound pair can never carry a valid request, and the derived-trigger rule cannot even run for it
every evidence[].source must resolve to an existing file INSIDE the repository

one record per corpus case; schema_version must equal the implemented version; closed vocabularies, per-class field equalities, trigger/class consistency, the disclosure-to-authority binding, the C_REJECT blocked-class rule, and structural rules that never mask a record's other defects

a disclosure that contradicts the object database is refused independently of what the record declares (a false historical_delta_touched_validator beside a provably validator-touching delta is an error even when the derived trigger is declared), and a record may not list its own class as BLOCKED

the verdict vocabulary for an entry describing a class the record CLAIMS is CLOSED (SHAPE_SATISFIED / SHAPE_SATISFIED_PENDING_MATERIALISATION): a synonym cannot stand in for 'blocked' on the record's own class
a non-object `disclosures` is a structured error, not a traceback
the disclosure cross-check runs on BOTH derived axes (test oracle and validator), each independent of what the record declares

the STATE TRANSITION itself, for an admissible class: the candidate revision's own acceptance surfaces are discovered from its tree and executed, byte-pinned, against materialised base and candidate worktrees (and against a controlled mutation), and the class is supported only if the measured verdicts move in the direction it claims

the provenance of each acceptance surface (DELTA_FROZEN / DELTA_ADDED / DELTA_MODIFIED), recomputed from the object database — a REWRITTEN acceptance is never a basis, because the delta rewrote the thing that judges it
oracle_authority, derived from the basis provenance: a DELTA_FROZEN basis requires FRAMEWORK_FROZEN, a DELTA_ADDED one requires DELTA_AUTHORED_DISCRIMINATING
the oracle-rewrite triggers fire on paths the delta REWRITES, not on paths it ADDS: an added acceptance cannot neuter an oracle that already existed
not_enforced_out_of_band_obligations: the TRUTH of baseline_oracle_status / mutation_oracle_status is never recomputed (this program cannot re-run a candidate's oracle): a record bound to a real corpus pair can still declare false statuses
whether the oracle really sits outside the worker's scope is a claim about a task design that does not exist yet
externalisation that silences a derived trigger is an assertion — it is bounded only by the fact that the same pending requirement forbids a valid request
the class itself is bound to nothing recomputable; the corpus's own per-case dispositions are deliberately not consulted, because the corpus header forbids collapsing those axes
ancestry is deliberately not required of C_REJECT (a non-comparable pair is a legitimate reject reason)
nothing compels a pending requirement to be discharged (liveness, not soundness)
the validator is not wired into prepare/collect/publish — Freeze v2 must decide whether it becomes a gate
enforcement.what_a_pass_means: the record is internally consistent and, where this repository can check it, consistent with the repository — not that the declared oracle statuses are true
